## Checklist

- [ ] The PR has a meaningful title and clear description.
- [ ] Tests covering the change have been added or updated.
- [ ] Python tests and lint checks pass.
- [ ] Rust tests, formatting, and Clippy pass when Rust code is affected.
- [ ] Documentation, examples, and notebooks are updated and clean.
- [ ] New mathematical methods cite an existing primary source where applicable.
